_readme: Hand-labelled covered walkways on the demo corridor (arcades, breezeways, solar canopies).
Each entry is a polyline of [lat, lng] points along the covered stretch.
Sample points within buffer_m metres of the line get at least `shade` (0-1) at every time of day.
Only add walkways someone has actually seen. Re-run `python -m backend.shade.build_shade` after editing.

walkways.name: Orange Mall solar canopy (Cady Mall to Hayden Mall)
walkways.note: Seen on Google Maps satellite imagery, 2026-11-14: solar shade structure about 108 m x 25 m over the mall, people walking under it. Not checked on foot.

walkways.name: Cady Mall solar canopy (south leg off Orange Mall)
walkways.note: Seen on Google Maps satellite imagery, 2026-11-14: solar shade structure about 29 m wide running south from the Orange Mall canopy. Not checked on foot.
